  • Method Details

    • getPrincipalPermissions

      Map<String,org.osgi.service.permissionadmin.PermissionInfo[]> getPrincipalPermissions()
      Returns the mapping of principal names to Java permissions. The permissions of a principal are represented as an array of PermissionInfo objects.

      The returned map may be modified without affecting the stored permissions.

      Returns:
      a Map containing principal names and the permissions associated with them

    • setPrincipalPermissions

      void setPrincipalPermissions(Map<String,org.osgi.service.permissionadmin.PermissionInfo[]> permissions) throws IOException
      Replaces the current permission table with the argument. The given map must contain String keys and PermissionInfo[] values, otherwise an exception is thrown.
      Parameters:
      permissions - the new set of principals and their permissions
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a key in the given Map is not a String or a value is not an array of PermissionInfo objects
      IOException - if there is an error updating the persistent permission store
